reviews.classification: bounded institution evidence, stale census and overgeneralized summary reconciled
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers the272-line input, W1–W4, F1–F10, eight engine-fact rows, C1–C8, every facility/role/price/gap row, later W5 and the October31/OW3 qualifications. W1–W4 total43526words; W5 adds18821, with19000 a rounded budget. These are bounded historical reader/source-check receipts, not a fresh whole-book read. Keep the supplied English edition SHA981c313a5f122272c0f6656df0071bfb43d37715e6ca20c10813a6341833e562, translation/provenance uncertainty and chapter/paragraph locators; no source-body passage was newly read here.

F2: The biennial auction line is Fang Yuan's saving plan, not the house's announced calendar. Gu rock purchase650after discount and free token-holder dissection remain distinct. Token issue count stays U despite the later engine-row shorthand; purple-thorn versus later Shang token identity needs qualification. Bidding/listing, secrecy versus actual leaks, appraisal versus recipe authenticity, private room, advance purchase and staff discipline are separate rights and risks. The inspected host permitting bluffs does not prove every host incapable of intervention. Jia sealed bids and Shang open outcry are compatible venue variants, not a contradiction.

F3: The battle betting-house ban does not establish a ban on forecast/information sales. The existing full-book institution owner already distinguishes the proposed information business, actual later operation, control-risk refusal and appointment. The opening pass's battle fees, surrender, custody and killing claims marked U cannot override that later source-indexed continuation. Clan jail is attributed thought; male inheritance and sect loyalty/exams are region/era observations, not all-world prohibitions. Keep sect3/8/15year exam distinctions, qualification versus office, and source-specific clan/sect contrasts.

F4: W5 supersedes parts of the old next-pass list: gate10/person and total20for two differ from600total at another gate;15discounted meal does not make inferred30a paid list price. Lodging pitches, care80/month rank-one with situational pricing, actual40620Gu sale, dealer offers and inferred recipe-bid units retain transaction state. Rumored10000courtesan invitation, customer seat charge and later token-holder29000purchase are not universal tariffs. Retail/rare auction/rank/region/era prices do not form one rank ladder. Coercive source institutions are documented fiction, not newly selected gameplay.

F5: Existing October31 comparison X1–X12/revisedP1 and B1–B5 current-code crosswalk qualify this dated pass; care versus commissioned refinement, purchase versus acquired control, actual fulfillment and one stock with competing uses remain distinct. Control of a held Gu does not supply a manufacture recipe. Preserve useful auction/custody, paid care, broker evidence, vouching/favor, recipe access and resource allocation ideas in their owners. The previously absent full-book directory now exists with source-indexed continuation; obsolete paths still need exact target selection, not reconstructed claims files. Retire the one-realm first-milestone deferral under current PROJECT. No new worker, acquisition, gameplay implementation or behavior proof is added.

F2: Academy private room, clothes and free meals are observed opening entitlements, not proof of universal free tuition. One four-week stay is not every intake duration. Citizenship's seventh rank has no established full scale. Gate tracking/duty is an institutional claim with no inspected universal penalty; Jet's tether advice is not a law that every independent dies.

F3: Credits, physical shards, contribution points, cohort draft priority and later shard-backed coins are distinct. The selected market shows shard/Memory/credit exchange, but no universal conversion rate or exact credit price. Seven cohorts of six in one42-recruit company do not define every group. Source statements about outskirts population, average yearly intake, rapid commissioning, shop turnover and healer scarcity retain speaker/era/local scope. A particular in-person Spell-assisted Memory transfer is not proof all later transfer methods require co-presence. Sunny's truth-answer Flaw cannot define every Flaw or borrowed original faculty.

F4: C1–C4 are integrated into the kit card: preserve market conversion without inventing a rate, civil rank beside Academy role and Spell rank, source-opening private board beside authored other-era lodging, and Jet/Caster as source-supported role candidates beside the explicitly original Hana Ward. Proposed credits5/20/30/40 stay authored, not recovered prices; board does not purchase mandatory disclosure. F5: Zero English keyword hits and missing fee lines apply to the inspected searches/windows, not all canon. Spell entry after first Nightmare, Academy preparation and an ordinary visitor are different starts; a candidate does not inherit later protagonist powers. Existing card's later guarded-rest proposals and source-qualified rank/body crossing must be preserved; no automatic sleep disaster or anti-exploit gate follows from this report. Date old no-pack/code findings, retire the first-milestone deferral, retain exact unopened clan/pay/services/market/late-volume ranges and [S]scope without revealing designed secrets. folds.heading: ## Institution pass C1–C4 reconciliation B605
folds.body:
The [institution pass](../../SHADOW_SLAVE_INSTITUTIONS_ROLES_AND_SUBTLE_DETAILS_2026-10-23.md#content-reconciliation-b605-institution-scope-and-private-board) qualifies C1–C4 for this card. C1: observed Sanctuary exchange permits shards for Memories/credits; there is no pinned general conversion rate. This does not automatically fund the authored depot. C2: the cited seventh-rank citizenship badge is a civil scale of unknown extent, distinct from school roles and Spell rank. C3: the inspected opening Academy grants a private room, clothes and free meals; shared accommodation remains an authored alternate-era arrangement, not that source scene. Counseling remains optional, and interview-based ranking is the narrator's inference.

C4: retain Hana Ward as original. Add source-supported cast candidates Master Jet (government adviser/handler; ask about support, duty or disclosure, with exact availability authored) and Caster (visible ranking peer; request a known comparison or practice only with a selected supported interaction). No schedule or playable conversation was recovered from a roster. Keep those roles separate from Julius/Rock instruction and from later-era staff. These are card-level proposals, with no new runtime roster or full-profile proof. Sunny's truthful-answer Flaw is specific; source board does not compel all personal disclosures. Three source stores of value can exchange locally without a universal rate or proposed5/20/30/40credit prices becoming canon.
